subject: E-Commerce
title: The $2 Trillion Opportunity
description: A quick, practical guide to The $2 Trillion Opportunity.

hook.text: Cross-border e-commerce hit $2 trillion in 2024. Over 70% of online shoppers have bought from a foreign store.

buildup.text: The internet erased geographic boundaries for information. E-commerce is slowly erasing them for goods.

discovery.text: Small brands now sell globally from day one. A soap maker in Portugal can reach customers in Japan instantly.

twist.text: Despite the opportunity, 60% of cross-border purchases involve returns, customs issues, or delivery problems.

climax.text: Cross-border e-commerce is massive but messy. The opportunity is real; the friction is also real.

punchline.text: $2 trillion, 60% have problems. Global shopping is booming but full of friction.

quiz.question: What percentage of cross-border purchases involve some kind of problem?
